freshnessPolicy: Automated results are current only when the test definition is unchanged, the recording was made from a clean tree, and (a) the tested revision equals HEAD or (b) the tested revision is an ancestor of HEAD and no path matching the test watch list changed in between. Manual results follow the same rules; an empty watch list claims no path dependency. If git cannot answer, the result is STALE. A result recorded from a dirty tree is STALE because it is not reproducible from a commit. Missing results are NOT_RUN, never PASS.

tests.title: Firefox GPU check: sticky header legibility and backdrop blur
procedure: Open http://127.0.0.1:3210/en/contact in Firefox on the Fedora host.
Set a 375x812 viewport (responsive mode), light theme, and scroll so the inquiry form sits behind the sticky header.
Toggle dark theme and scroll the same form behind the header.
Submit the empty form to show the validation-error state and scroll it behind the header.
Repeat the light-theme scrolled-form check at 320x720.
Open the mobile drawer, confirm it is opaque, focused on Close, and Escape restores focus.
Record whether the header surface visibly blurs the scrolled content behind it, and whether header text stays legible.
Save screenshots to test-results/manual/firefox/ and record this test with those evidence paths.
tests.expected: Header navigation remains legible over scrolled content in both themes; the glass surface visibly blurs rather than showing doubled text; sticky and drawer behaviour are unchanged.
tests.evidence: Firefox screenshots for light/dark, scrolled form, error state, 320 and 375 widths, plus the open drawer.

tests.title: Chromium and Firefox critical-path parity
procedure: In Chromium and Firefox, load the homepage, services, work, about, contact and privacy pages in FA/EN/AR.
Check navigation, language switching, theme switching, mobile drawer, keyboard focus and the inquiry form default/error states.
Compare against the WebKitGTK evidence for layout, overflow and direction regressions.
Record each engine, version and OS with screenshots of any difference.
tests.expected: No critical-path layout, direction, focus or form regression in either engine; differences are documented rather than assumed.
tests.evidence: Screenshots per engine and locale for the critical paths, plus a short findings note.

tests.title: Keyboard-only and screen-reader spot check
procedure: Navigate every marketing page with the keyboard only: skip link, header, navigation, language/theme controls, main content, footer.
Confirm visible focus, logical order, no traps, Escape closes the drawer and focus returns to the trigger.
Submit the inquiry form with invalid and valid data using the keyboard only.
Run a screen-reader spot check on homepage, contact form and about page in at least one locale.
Record assistive technology and browser versions.
tests.expected: All interactive elements are reachable and operable, focus is visible and restored, errors are announced, and no keyboard trap exists.
tests.evidence: Findings per page with browser/AT versions; screenshots are optional, notes are required.

tests.title: 200% zoom and reflow check
procedure: Set browser zoom to 200% at a 1440x900 window.
Check every listed page for clipped text, hidden controls, horizontal scrolling and overlapping sticky elements.
Repeat on a 375x812 viewport at 200% text scaling if the browser supports it.
Record affected pages and screenshots.
tests.expected: Content reflows without loss of information or controls; no unintended horizontal scrolling.
tests.evidence: Screenshots or notes for each page and locale.

tests.title: Native Persian copy and typography review
procedure: Read every FA page against the approved terminology file.
Check Persian punctuation, half-spaces, number and date formatting, and mixed Latin tokens.
Check font loading, Arabic/Persian shaping and content expansion at 320 and 375 widths.
Report wording that implies unverified team size, clients, metrics or credentials.
tests.expected: Copy is natural, terminology is consistent, shaping is correct and no unsupported business claim is visible.
tests.evidence: Reviewer notes per page and locale; screenshots for any typography defect.

tests.title: Native Arabic copy and typography review
procedure: Read every AR page against the approved terminology file.
Check Arabic punctuation, number shaping, mixed Latin tokens and RTL bidi isolation.
Check font loading, Arabic shaping and content expansion at 320 and 375 widths.
Report wording that implies unverified team size, clients, metrics or credentials.
tests.expected: Copy is natural, terminology is consistent, shaping is correct and no unsupported business claim is visible.
tests.evidence: Reviewer notes per page and locale; screenshots for any typography defect.

tests.title: Localized 404, canonical and social metadata review
procedure: Open unknown routes under each locale and confirm the localized 404 document and navigable header or back link.
Inspect canonical URLs, hreflang, OG tags and robots directives for preview and public states.
Confirm preview noindex behaviour is still intentional and documented.
Record pages checked and any mismatch.
tests.expected: 404 pages are usable and localized; metadata matches the documented preview policy; no preview noindex removal.
tests.evidence: Screenshot of each 404 plus copied metadata values.

tests.title: Owner visual acceptance against the approved reference
procedure: Review the regenerated evidence bundle and the live site in the owner's browser.
Confirm hierarchy, spacing, typography, card treatment and theme consistency still match the approved reference.
Confirm the header glass and About copy read well in light and dark themes.
Record approval or specific defects with screenshots.
tests.expected: Owner accepts the visual result; unresolved defects are listed as findings rather than silently approved.
tests.evidence: Owner screenshots or a written approval referencing the evidence bundle.

tests.title: Privacy policy and legal wording approval
procedure: Review the privacy page, cookie/local-preference disclosure and inquiry data handling against actual implementation.
Confirm retention, deletion and operator access wording before public launch.
Record approval or required changes; do not infer consent from technical tests.
tests.expected: Legal/privacy wording is accurate for the implemented system and explicitly approved.
tests.evidence: Written approval or listed required changes.

tests.title: Owner release sign-off
procedure: Confirm every release-relevant automated test passed at the release commit.
Confirm every required manual case passed with evidence and all owner/legal gates are recorded.
Confirm deployment, rollback and operational readiness are documented.
Record the decision and commit in the manual result.
tests.expected: An explicit owner decision that release may proceed; absence of a decision is not approval.
tests.evidence: Owner decision text with the release commit hash.
